mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by more than 2% y-o-y, it signals a supply crunch that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth slows by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth accelerates by more than 20% y-o-y, it signals overexuberance in the housing market that will lead to a slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y HOUST growth > 20% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 100k jobs per month for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 2mo PAYEMS growth < -100k but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real retail sales growth slows by more than 2% y-o-y, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y RSAFS growth slows by > 2% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate rises above 3% y-o-y, it signals rising inflationary pressures that will drive the Fed to tighten policy and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y CPIAUCSL inflation > 3% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances.
